name: image-to-code
description: Convert a UI screenshot, mockup, or design image into production-quality frontend code. Analyzes layout, spacing, component hierarchy, and visual states from the image, then outputs clean, semantic code. Use when the user provides an image/screenshot and asks to "code this", "build this UI", "implement this design", or "turn this into a component". Do NOT use for generating new designs — only for converting existing visuals to code.
